title: Grape Pilaf with Grilled Nuts
description: A flavorful and healthy Chinese-inspired dish featuring grilled nuts and pilaf with a sweet twist from fresh grapes.
instructions: 1. Cook the pilaf according to package instructions.
2. In a large skillet or wok, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
3. Add the sliced peanuts and stir-fry until fragrant and lightly toasted.
4. Add the cooked pilaf to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
5. Add the halved grapes to the skillet and stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes.
6. Season with soy sauce to taste.
7. Serve the pilaf mixture in individual portions and garnish with additional peanuts if desired.
